info.title: pi-durable-sessions
info.description: The worker's REST API (worker/src/index.js). So far only the Session list and create endpoints; worker/contract.check.mjs fails when the worker and this file disagree. The Session WebSocket (/api/session/{id}/ws) is not described here.

get.summary: Every Session, most recently active first
get.description: The Directory cell's rows. The web app gets the same list pushed over /api/directory/ws.

post.description: Named after the repo (or "untitled") until the first message titles it, unless `name` is given. The Session's sandbox starts cloning `repo` right away.

name.description: An explicit name; otherwise the first message titles the Session

repo.description: Git URL cloned into /workspace/<repo name>; blank means none

branch.description: Branch to check out; blank means the default

Session.description: A Session as the create response, the Directory list and the Session cell's meta frame report it. Each carries a different subset of the optional fields.

cwd.description: The agent's working directory in the sandbox

titled.description: Named explicitly, by a rename or by the automatic title; not in Directory rows

lastActivity.description: Directory rows only; milliseconds since the epoch

archivedAt.description: When it was archived; null or absent when active

Error.description: The request failed: a body that is not JSON, or a cell that threw
